newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean inflation 0.4 pct in November--official.
newsitem.headline: Chilean inflation 0.4 pct in November--official.

text.p: Chilean consumer prices rose 0.4 percent in November, compared to a rise of 0.1 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute reported.
The rise suggested the government will have little or no room to spare in achieving its official target for the year of a rise of 6.5 percent in consumer prices.
The November figure brought price rises for the first 11 months of the year to 6.2 percent, and 6.6 percent over the past 12 months, the institute said.
Prices on exportable goods rose 0.9 percent, and prices on non-exportable goods rose 0.1 percent.
By category, food prices rose 0.3 percent, as did housing and apparel prices, while transport and communications prices rose 1.1 percent. The catch-all "other" category was unchanged.
